subject.title: fix(qqbot): add timeout to speech transcription requests

question: Should QQBot STT adopt this PR's 30s default request deadline for existing users, or should the fallback be tuned before merge?
rationale: The code path is narrow and the unsupported QQBot-specific timeout keys were removed, but choosing a default timeout can intentionally change existing slow-STT behavior.

options.title: Accept the 30s default
options.body: Merge as-is and include release-note context that slower STT endpoints should raise existing provider or media timeoutSeconds configuration.

options.title: Tune the fallback first
options.body: Change DEFAULT_STT_TIMEOUT_MS to an owner-approved value, such as aligning more closely with media audio defaults, and update the focused expectations before merge.

options.title: Ask for live provider proof
options.body: Pause until QQBot or third-party STT proof shows the default is appropriate for real slow transcription endpoints.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30s default
recommendation.body: Merge as-is and include release-note context that slower STT endpoints should raise existing provider or media timeoutSeconds configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: The original QQBot channel owner is the strongest history signal for a QQBot-specific runtime default decision.
